headline: UK ONS Releases October 2026 Consumer Price Inflation Data
summary: The UK Office for National Statistics has published price indices and percentage changes for consumer price inflation metrics for October 2026.
why: The Office for National Statistics is the UK's official statistical authority. Its CPI figures guide Bank of England monetary policy decisions.

impacts.name: United Kingdom
impacts.why: Official inflation data directly influences interest rate expectations and British sovereign bond yields.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
